## 4. Load Files
```{r Load-Files}
## GFP Summaries
gfp1_9_summary  <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP1_9_mapping_summary.tsv")
gfp10_11_summary <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP10_11_mapping_summary.tsv")

## featureCounts
featcount <- read_tsv("../HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt", skip = 1)
library(dplyr)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)]
read.count <- as.matrix(featcount %>% select(all_of(count_cols)))
rownames(read.count) <- featcount[[1]]

stopifnot(ncol(featcount) > 6)
```

## 5. Clean Data
```{r Clean-Data}
  ## Clean colnames (remove .bam paths)
colnames(read.count) <- gsub(".*\\/|\\..*Aligned.*", "", colnames(read.count))
sample_names <- c(
  "IT-107","IT-108","IT-109","IT-110",
  "H-107","H-108","H-109","H-110","H-111",
  "UT-106","UT-108","UT-114",
  "IT-206","IT-207","IT-208","IT-209",
  "IM-206","IM-207","IM-208","IM-209","IM-210",
  "UT-204","UT-208","UT-213","UT-214",
  "UM-204","UM-208","UM-213","UM-214","UM-215")
stopifnot(
  length(sample_names) == ncol(read.count),
  nrow(gfp1_9_summary) == length(sample_names),
  nrow(gfp10_11_summary) == length(sample_names))

colnames(read.count) <- sample_names
gfp1_9_summary$sample_id  <- sample_names
gfp10_11_summary$sample_id <- sample_names
cat("Counts:", nrow(read.count), "genes x", ncol(read.count), "samples\n")

  ## METADATA
sample_info <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(read.count)) %>%
  mutate(
    extraction = if_else(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"), "TRAP", "CLE"),
    trt = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-")  ~ "H",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IM-") ~ "IM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UM-") ~ "UM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IT-") ~ "IT",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UT-") ~ "UT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
    line = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-") ~ "DMR6pPETEp",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^(IM|UM)-") ~ "35SpPETEp",
      TRUE ~ "bulk")
  )

sample_info$trt <- factor(sample_info$trt, levels = c("UM","UT","IM","IT","H"))
sample_info <- as.data.frame(sample_info)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample_id

stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(read.count)))
table(sample_info$trt, sample_info$extraction)

  ## WRITE EXCEL
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp1_9_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp1_9_summary.xlsx"))
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp10_11_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp10_11_summary.xlsx"))

  ## SUBSET
subset_groups <- function(df) df %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
gfp1_9_h_im_um  <- subset_groups(gfp1_9_summary)
gfp10_11_h_im_um <- subset_groups(gfp10_11_summary)

subset_info <- function(sample_info) sample_info %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
HvUMvIM_info <- subset_info(sample_info)

  ## SET Up For Estimation
#TRAP Only
trap_cols <- grep("^(H|IM|UM)-", colnames(read.count), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(trap_cols) > 0)
trap.count <- read.count[, trap_cols, drop = FALSE]
genome_total_reads <- colSums(trap.count)
```

## 7. UM BG and H Ref
```{r UM BG and H Ref}
# Compute GFP fractions
gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  mutate (gfp_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / total_reads)

# UM Background
UM_bg <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  summarise(bg = mean(gfp_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(bg)

# H = DMR6 reference
H_ref <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "H") %>%
  summarise(ref = mean(gfp_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(ref)
stopifnot(!is.na(UM_bg), !is.na(H_ref), H_ref > 0)

# IM correction
im_haust <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "IM") %>%
  mutate(haust_index = pmax((gfp_frac - UM_bg) / H_ref, 0),  # UM-corrected, relative to H
    haust_pct  = haust_index * 100)
 
  ## PLOT
ggplot(im_haust, aes(x = sample_id, y = haust_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IM" = "#E69FBC")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Estimated Haustorial Signal in IM Samples",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Haustorial Signal (relative to H)"
  )
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Raw_vs_UMCorrected_Fractions.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Compute H reference per sample
h_ref_per_sample <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "H") %>%
  select(sample_id, gfp_frac)

# Normalize all haust fractions relative to mean H
H_mean <- mean(h_ref_per_sample$gfp_frac, na.rm = TRUE)

all_haust_norm <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  mutate(haust_frac = case_when (
    condition == "UM" ~ gfp_frac / H_mean,                        # scaled relative to mean H
      condition == "IM" ~ im_haust$haust_frac[match(sample_id, im_haust$sample_id)], # background-corrected
      condition == "H"  ~ gfp_frac / H_mean                         # normalize H to 1
    )) %>%
  # Label fractions > 1 for plotting
  mutate(label = ifelse(haust_frac > 1, paste0(round(haust_frac * 100), "%"), NA))

# Plot
ggplot(all_haust_norm, aes(x = sample_id, y = haust_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(all_haust_norm$haust_frac, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "UM" = "#999999",
    "IM" = "#E69FBC",
    "H"  = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Haustorial Index Across All Conditions (Normalized to H)",
    y = "Haustorial Index (relative to mean H)",
    x = "Sample"
  )

ggplot(gfp1_9_h_im_um, aes(x = sample_id, y = gfp_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6, position = "dodge") +
geom_hline(yintercept = H_ref, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("UM" = "#8C8C8C", "IM" = "#E69FBC", "H" = "#56B4E9")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(title = "GFP1-9 Mapped Fraction by Condition",
       subtitle = "IM background-corrected for UM; H = reference haustoria fraction",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Mapped Fraction")
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GFP_FractionByCondition.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggplot(gfp1_9_h_im_um,
       aes(x = condition, y = gfp_frac, color = condition)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = UM_bg,
             linetype = "dotted", color = "gray30", size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = H_ref,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "UM" = "#8C8C8C",
    "IM" = "#E69FBC",
    "H"  = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "GFP1–9 Mapped Fraction Across TRAP Samples",
    subtitle = "Dotted line = UM background; dashed line = H reference",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "GFP1–9 Mapped Fraction"
  ) + 
geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 3)
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "UMbg_Href.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 8. TRAP Count H Correction
```{r}
trap_long <- trap.count %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -gene_id,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "raw_counts"
  ) %>%
  # Add sample info
  left_join(gfp1_9_h_im_um %>% select(sample_id, condition, total_reads), by = "sample_id") %>%
  # Add IM haust fractions
  left_join(im_haust %>% select(sample_id, haust_frac), by = "sample_id")
stopifnot(all(c("gene_id","sample_id","raw_counts","condition") %in% colnames(trap_long)))

gene_um_bg <- trap_long %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(um_mean = mean(raw_counts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Peek at whats going on gene wise
trap_corrected <- trap_long %>%
  # Join UM background per gene
  left_join(gene_um_bg, by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(haust_gene_counts = case_when(
      condition == "IM" ~ pmax((raw_counts - um_mean) * haust_frac, 0), # UM-corrected & scaled by haust_frac
      condition == "H" ~ raw_counts - um_mean, # UM-corrected only
      TRUE ~ raw_counts), # UM stays as-is
    haust_gene_counts = ifelse(haust_gene_counts < 0, 0, haust_gene_counts)) # ensure no negative counts

trap_corrected %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% c("AT1G01010", "AT1G01080"),
         condition %in% c("UM", "IM", "H")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(sample_id, haust_gene_counts, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Estimated haustorial TRAP counts",
    fill = "Condition")
```

## 9. Matrix and DESeq Run
```{r DESeq2}
trap_matrix <- trap_corrected %>%
  filter(sample_id != "IM-207" )  %>%
  select(gene_id, sample_id, haust_gene_counts) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = haust_gene_counts,
    values_fill = 0   # replace missing values with 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

coldata <- trap_corrected %>%
    filter(sample_id != "IM-207" )  %>%
  select(sample_id, condition) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
stopifnot(all(colnames(trap_matrix) == rownames(coldata)))

## DESEQ
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(trap_matrix),
  colData   = coldata,
  design    = ~ condition)

dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ] # Prefilter low counts
dds <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts")
res_H_vs_IM <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "H", "IM"))
```


```{r}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res_H_vs_IM) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  arrange(padj)

top_genes <- res_df %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FoldChange), n = 3) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "norm_count") %>%
  left_join(coldata %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")

ggplot(norm_counts %>% 
         filter(gene_id %in% top_genes), aes(x=sample_id, y = norm_count, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))
```

## 10. Top Genes
```{r}
library(broom)
plot_DE_vs_haust_facet <- function(
  dds,
  res_df,
  im_haust,
  top_n = 2,
  log_scale = TRUE,
  pseudocount = 1) {
  ## Top up/down DE genes
top_up <- res_df %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange > 1) %>%
  slice_max(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
top_down <- res_df %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange < -1) %>%
  slice_min(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
top_gene_ids <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
  pull(gene_id)
  ## Norm Counts
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "norm_count")
  ## Add sample info
sample_info_df <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  select(sample_id, condition)
  ## MERGE
plot_df <- norm_counts %>%
  left_join(sample_info_df, by = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(im_haust %>% select(sample_id, haust_frac), by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(condition == "IM", gene_id %in% top_gene_ids)  %>%
    mutate(norm_count_pc = norm_count + pseudocount)

# CHECKS
stopifnot(!anyNA(plot_df$haust_frac))
stopifnot(!anyNA(plot_df$norm_count_pc))

  ## LINEAR MODEL STATS
lm_stats <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
    do(tidy(lm(norm_count_pc ~ haust_frac, data = .))) %>%
  filter(term == "haust_frac") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(
    "β = ", round(estimate, 2),
    "\nP = ", signif(p.value, 2)))
  
  ## PLOT
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = haust_frac, y = norm_count)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_text(
      data = lm_stats,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top", top_n, "DE Genes: Expression vs Haustorial Fraction (IM)"),
      x = "Haustorial Fraction (UM-corrected)",
      y = "Normalized TRAP Counts (+ pseudocount)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

  if (log_scale) {
    p <- p + scale_y_log10(
      breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 5),
      labels = scales::label_number()
    )
  }

  return(p)
}

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Top_DE_genes_vs_Haust_frac.png"), width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```



```{r}
library(fgsea)
library(enrichplot)
# ENTREZ ID mapping
res_haust_entrez <- res_df %>%
  mutate(entrez = mapIds(
    org.At.tair.db,
    keys = gene_id,
    column = "ENTREZID",
    keytype = "TAIR",
    multiVals = "first"
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(entrez))
sum(is.na(res_haust_entrez$entrez))  # 0 after filtering

# Ranked gene list for GSEA
gene_list <- res_haust_entrez$log2FoldChange
names(gene_list) <- res_haust_entrez$entrez
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

gse <- gseGO(
  geneList      = gene_list,
  OrgDb         = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

gene_sets <- gse@geneSets  # list of ENTREZ IDs per GO term

fgsea_res <- fgsea(
  pathways = gene_sets,
  stats    = gene_list,   # ranked gene list
  minSize  = 10,
  maxSize  = 500,
    eps      = 0 )
fgsea_res_clean <- fgsea_res %>% filter(!is.na(pval))

top_n <- min(10, nrow(fgsea_res_clean))
top_pathways <- fgsea_res_clean %>% arrange(pval) %>% head(top_n)
top_pathways


# Plot top terms

ego <- enrichGO(
  gene          = res_haust_entrez$entrez,
  OrgDb         = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)
head(ego, 10)

# Make sure gse is your gseGO object
top_gsea_ids <- seq_len(min(5, nrow(gse@result)))  # pick top 5 pathways

# Correct function name
gseaplot2(gse, geneSetID = top_gsea_ids)
```

```{r Maybe look at other markers?}
keep_um <- sample_info_trap$trt == "UM"  # Pure mock mesophyll
h_um_baseline <- mean(sample_info_trap$h_index[keep_um])

h_summary_um <- sample_info_trap %>%
  mutate(H_index_UM = h_index / h_um_baseline) %>%
  group_by(line) %>%
  summarise(mean_H_UM = mean(H_index_UM))


h_summary <- sample_info_trap %>%
  group_by(trt) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_h = mean(h_index),
    se_h = sd(h_index) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = mean_h[trt == "UM"],  # Store 35S value
    H_index = mean_h / baseline) %>%
  select(-baseline)  # Clean up

print(" Raw H-index (H/IM/UM):")
print(h_summary)
```
